reviews.author: Ellen McElveen
reviews.text: Having just moved to Burlington and bought our first house, we had never hired an electrician before. After a storm, the lights on the 2nd floor stopped working. We were a bit intimidated not knowing how much we'd have to pay for the job. We called Harris Electrical and they came out quickly, were super informative and professional and did the job within a reasonable price. We also talked about future electrical changes we'd like to make and would like to keep working with them. Thank you both for your help!

reviews.author: Stephen Good
reviews.text: We had been battling some electrical problems for over a year now. Other electricians charged us fees to come out, diagnose, and replace parts, and were still not able to fix the problem. When the issue got worse, I came across Harris Electrical. The owner was amazing! He returned my call after hours and listened to my concerns. Being a do-it-yourselfer, he gave me tips on things I could try before paying him to come out. I never felt rushed or pressured into spending money on something that I didn't need. Within 2 phone calls he not only diagnose the problem, he got it right the first time! If I ever need electrical work done he will be my first call. 5 stars are not enough to recognize his professionalism and skill.
